newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe Steel sees 98/99 capex rising to 80 bln yen.
newsitem.headline: Kobe Steel sees 98/99 capex rising to 80 bln yen.

text.p: Kobe Steel Corp said on Friday it expected its capital spending in fiscal 1998/99 to rise to 80 billion yen.
The company announced earlier that it expected capital spending of 61 billion yen in 1997/98.
Noriyoshi Mitsutake, a managing director at Kobe Steel, said capital spending in 1997/98 and 1998/99 would focus on rationalisation of operations and overhauling existing facilities.
In 1998/99, Kobe plans to overhaul its steel wire plant in Kakogawa, in western Japan, where it will also build an electric power plant that will sell electricity, he said.
